comment: shk.c u_entered_shop() lines 833-836: a shopkeeper whose shop was robbed in an earlier game greets a new customer by muttering imprecations against shoplifters. Segment 1: a debug Valkyrie (named 'wizard' by debug mode) level-teleports to D:2 of seed 5310076, where she arrives in a general store, picks up an expensive camera, ^T-teleports out (rob_shop() adds 267 to robbed and hot_pursuit() makes the keeper follow), zaps herself with a wand of death, and saves bones; inherits() takes her possessions but subtracts only her 0 gold from robbed. Segment 2: an ordinary Archeologist named Passerby digs through D:1 and falls into that shop on the bones level (getbones()'s rn2(3) is 0 for this seed); restshk() pacifies the keeper because the customer differs, and u_entered_shop()'s new-customer branch resets following and pacifies again, so neither the anger nor the surcharge arm applies and robbed > 0 gives the mutter. The Deaf arm (838-839) is not reached: no ordinary-mode role can be made deaf on demand. The final keys dismiss the remaining --More-- prompts.
